name: Open Disputes
query:
SELECT
  dc.name as "Dispute:Link/Dispute Case:150",
  dc.contract as "Contract:Link/Contract:150",
  dc.milestone as "Milestone:Link/Milestone:150",
  dc.raised_by as "Raised By::180",
  dc.against as "Against::100",
  dc.status as "Status::140",
  dc.arbitration_deadline as "Arbitration Deadline:Date:150",
  DATEDIFF(dc.arbitration_deadline, CURDATE()) as "Days Left:Int:100"
FROM `tabDispute Case` dc
WHERE dc.status IN ('Open', 'Under Review')
ORDER BY dc.arbitration_deadline ASC
